name: clawd-hq
description: A virtual office side panel: Clawd runs the floor, every subagent is an employee at a desk

chiefOfStaff.title: Clawd runs the chat
chiefOfStaff.description: On (default): the main chat works as Clawd, the chief of staff. He hands real work to specialists, asks you only what needs you, and reports in plain words. Off: Claude behaves as usual and you keep the panel.

voiceFile.title: Your own voice file
voiceFile.description: The full path of a text file that sets how Clawd sounds, in place of his built-in voice. It changes his tone only, never his rules. Leave empty for the built-in voice. Read when a session starts, up to 8000 characters. When set, it wins over your own copy from the Settings tab, and the tab shows and edits this file instead.

recap.title: Recap on Clawd's card
recap.description: On (default): after at least three turns and three quiet minutes, Clawd's card shows one line on where things stand, the way Claude Code's own session recap does. It asks the model one short question about the session, which uses a little of your plan. Off: no recap is made.

quietChat.title: Quiet chat
quietChat.description: On (default): while Clawd runs the chat, it hides the 'finished' notices of specialists he hired, the messages of teammates he hired by name, and his own no-update lines. He reports once the job is done, and the Settings tab lists what finished. A failure or a request (a question, permission, approval) always shows, and the full view (ctrl+o) shows everything. Off: the chat shows every row as Claude Code draws it.

youShouldKnow.title: You should know
youShouldKnow.description: On (default): after each specialist hands its work back, and after any turn of Clawd's own that used six tools or more, a small model reads the steps and the report and may leave one short note on Clawd's card when something matters, such as a claim no step backs up or a test that failed. Checks are made only while one of the office tabs is open. It uses a little of your plan. While it is on and an office tab is open, Claude Code's own "You should know" note above the prompt box stays quiet. Off: no checks are made, and Claude Code's own note works as usual.

leftUndone.title: Left undone check
leftUndone.description: On (default): after a turn of Clawd's own that used five tools or more, a small model sets your request against his final report and lists what you asked for that was not done, in the Left undone section of the Office tab. It uses a little of your plan. Off: that check is not made. The other two sources (deferring sentences in answers and unfinished-work lines written into files) are read on this machine and are not affected.
